name: Plan B
description: Plan B offers clients the chance to travel back in time to change the past, but each alteration has unintended consequences, revealing the complexity and limitations of personal agency.

videos.title: Push to Start
videos.overview: A mysterious hotline gives Philip the chance to go back in time to fix his relationship.

videos.title: The Answer
videos.overview: Despite working hard to make it perfect, Philip's life still isn't going according to plan.

videos.title: The Reason
videos.overview: Philip finds himself resentful about what he knows is about to happen in the future.

videos.title: Irrelevance
videos.overview: Despite Evelyn's obvious love for him, Philip can't shake his jealousy.

videos.title: Dreaming While Awake
videos.overview: This time Philip's sure he has the perfect Plan B to make his dreams come true.

videos.title: The Thing You Cannot Undo
videos.overview: When Philip's perfect world is hit hard by reality, he decides on a very different plan B.

videos.title: Allegiance
videos.overview: Police officer Mia Coleman is haunted by a case involving a murder-suicide. She calls the Plan B agency, determined to go back in time and prevent the tragedy.

videos.title: Harm Reduction
videos.overview: Traveling back in time to prevent a murder-suicide, Mia kidnaps the would-be killer, but her plan backfires, leaving blood on her own hands in her pursuit of justice.

videos.title: I'm Not Scared
videos.overview: Suspended from duty, Mia's determination to prevent a sexual assault leads her down a path of vigilante justice, blurring the lines between her police work and her personal vendetta.

videos.title: Ten Minutes
videos.overview: Mia travels farther back in time to protect Keri from her abusive husband, forcing Mia into proximity with her own ex-boyfriend Bryson and confronting her with the complexities of their relationship.

videos.title: Elephants
videos.overview: Mia seeks therapy to address her controlling behaviour. Paul attends counseling while Mia supervises his visits with his daughters. Mia's unresolved issues resurface, leading to a family confrontation.

videos.title: Only Going Backwards
videos.overview: Paul attempts to reconcile with Keri, but his anger resurfaces. While Mia confronts her own demons and makes a change, Paul seeks redemption.

videos.title: Faded
videos.overview: When her teenage daughter Lucy takes her own life, television host Abigail Walker is given the opportunity to reboot the past, courtesy of mysterious agency Plan B.

videos.title: Trigger Warning
videos.overview: Desperately hoping to change the events that led to Lucy taking her own life, Abigail discovers that the underlying reasons are far more complicated than a quick fix will allow.

videos.title: Temptation
videos.overview: Abigail attempts to thwart fate by going further back into the past, and an idyllic family trip to Ottawa is derailed when Lucy goes missing.

videos.title: Past Is Present
videos.overview: Locked into a sixty-day trip into the past, Abigail gives herself a holiday from responsibility, but then decides a far more drastic use of Plan B is needed to save Lucy.

videos.title: As Time Goes By
videos.overview: Ignoring the advice to not go too far into the past, Abigail desperately grabs a second chance at raising two pre-teens, and re-evaluating her own life choices.

videos.title: Here Now
videos.overview: Lucy has survived beyond the designated date of her death, but what she reveals to Abigail completely upends all she thought she knew.
